oneParagraphVerdict: The chapter has a solid core idea: visible weekly measurement replaces intention with evidence while there is still time to adjust. A few lines make that memorable. But it is not publishable at a professional bar because the execution is visibly rough: grammar errors, cut-off paragraphs, scaffold residue, mismatched examples, repetitive template language, and a quiz whose key can be guessed from pattern and phrasing. The lesson is useful, but the page needs a serious cleanup before it should ship.
